findings.title: A task that survives its cancel stage does not trigger the hard exit
findings.why_it_matters: asyncio.run waits for the supervisor kill.
findings.recommended: B: Accept as a known limitation: a task that swallows cancellation at exit is ended by the supervisor's kill rather than the hard exit.

findings.title: The entry-deadline walk-away awaits registry cleanup with no bound
findings.why_it_matters: A wedged DB worker holds the app-key lock until restart.
